description: This file defines a command-line tool component for transcribing media files, utilizing AVFoundation, Speech, and custom classes for audio transcription. It handles input arguments, sets up the transcription process, and outputs the transcribed text.

classes.name: TranscribeCommand
classes.description: A command structure that encapsulates the transcription functionality, parsing arguments and executing the process asynchronously.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously performs the transcription of the input media file and outputs the result to a file or console.
